title: Peter Rizun, Andrew Stone -- 1 GB Block Tests -- Scaling Bitcoin Stanford.
summary: Peter Rizun and Andrew Stone present results of tests running 1 GB blocks on a Bitcoin test network at Scaling Bitcoin Stanford. The talk argues for big-block scaling and discusses its consequences.
why: Cited by big-block advocates as evidence that Bitcoin could handle far higher throughput.

quote.text: A good talk about really big blocks on bitcoin and what the ramifications are;
